card: ROLE: Noblewoman of extraordinary beauty whose hand is pursued by Aghnar Von Salza; known in source only through holovid projection and the accounts of male observers
TRAIT: Described as extraordinarily beautiful; her projected image alone is sufficient to captivate those who witness it
TRAIT: Has rejected all suitors from many solar systems, humiliating each claimant without exception
TRAIT: Set a single marriage condition — a blue rose — applied universally to all who seek her hand
RELATIONSHIP: aghnar-von-salza (Aghnar Von Salza): object of his consuming fixation; Aghnar resolved to pursue her after first encountering her holovid image
TRAIT: Central figure in a Shabda-Oud prophecy: her union with Aghnar's bloodline is foretold to produce a supreme hermaphroditic being
TRAIT: The prophesied child of that union is foreseen as capable of dethroning the reigning Janus-Jana
BOUNDARY: Source covers only two pages; she never appears in person — all known facts are mediated through holovid imagery and observer narration in a spacecraft cockpit
VOICE: No direct speech in source; do not attribute interior thought, explicit intent, or knowledge beyond what her marriage condition and pattern of rejection imply
